2607.08173.title: Overthinking: Amplifying Reasoning Weights to Extract Learned Secrets
2607.08173.paper_summary: Black box auditing of language models is an essential pre-deployment tool, but it may miss subtle forms of misalignment and hidden information. To better elicit hidden information during an auditing process, we introduce \emph{overthinking}: the process of using reasoning task vectors to amplify the propensity to think out loud of reasoning models. Given the parameters of a non-reasoning instruct model $M$ and reasoning-distilled model $R$, we define the \emph{overthinking model} as $\boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{O}_α} = \boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{M}} + α(\boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{R}} - \boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{M}})$, where $α> 1$ amplifies reasoning beyond the pure reasoning model $R$. Additionally, we introduce new layer-wise attenuation strategies that selectively amplify reasoning without losing quality and coherence of model outputs. We demonstrate that overthinking models are more likely to reveal hidden information across four experimental settings, across 2B-32B models. Our findings suggest that reasoning amplification may surface secrets or unintended behaviors acquired during training up to $10\times$ more frequently than the original reasoning model. How secrets surface depends on the secret type: some require perturbation along the reasoning direction, while others yield to any sufficiently large weight perturbation.
2607.08173.paper_summary_zh: 黑箱審計語言模型是部署前的重要工具，但它可能會錯過微妙的錯位形式和隱藏信息。為了在審計過程中更好地引出隱藏信息，我們引入了\emph{過度思考}：使用推理任務向量來放大推理模型的即時思考傾向的過程。給定非推理指令模型$M$和推理提煉模型$R$的參數，我們將\emph{過度思考模型}定義為$\boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{O}_α} = \boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{M}} + α(\boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{R}} - \boldsymbolθ_{\mathcal{M}})$，其中$α> 1$將推理放大到超過純推理模型$R$的程度。此外，我們引入了新的層級衰減策略，這些策略選擇性地放大推理，而不失去模型輸出的質量和一致性。我們展示了過度思考模型在四個實驗設置中更有可能揭示隱藏信息，涵蓋2B-32B模型。我們的發現表明，推理放大可能比原始推理模型更頻繁地揭示在訓練過程中獲得的秘密或意外行為，頻率高達$10\times$。秘密的顯現取決於秘密的類型：有些需要沿著推理方向的擾動，而其他則對任何足夠大的權重擾動作出反應。
